title: Susitikimas kavinėje
transcriptLt: Labas, Toma! Kur tu esi? Aš jau kavinėje. Labas, Minedai! Būsiu už penkių minučių.
transcriptEn: Hello, Tomas! Where are you? I'm already at the cafe. Hello, Minedas! I'll be there in five minutes.

questions.questionText: Where is Tomas currently waiting?
questions.explanation: Tomas says 'Aš jau kavinėje' which translates to 'I am already in the cafe'.

questions.questionText: When will the other person arrive?
questions.explanation: She responds with 'Būsiu už penkių minučių' (I will be there in five minutes).

title: Kava išsinešimui
transcriptLt: Labas, ar galiu gauti kavos, prašau? Labas! Taip, vietoje ar išsinešimui? Išsinešimui, prašau. Gerai, kokio dydžio? Mažą, ačiū. Gerai, viena sekundė.
transcriptEn: Hi, can I get a coffee, please? Hi! Yes, to stay or to go? To go, please. Okay, what size? Small, thank you. Okay, just a second.

questions.questionText: Does the customer want to drink the coffee at the cafe?
questions.explanation: He asks for 'Išsinešimui, prašau' which means 'To go, please'.

questions.questionText: What size coffee does he ask for?
questions.explanation: He orders 'Mažą, ačiū' (Small, thank you).

title: Didelė juoda kava
transcriptLt: Laba diena, prašau vieną juodą kavą. Laba diena. Gersite čia ar išsinešite? Išsinešimui. Didelę ar mažą? Didelę, ačiū. Tuoj bus!
transcriptEn: Good day, one black coffee please. Good day. Will you drink here or take away? To go. Large or small? Large, thank you. Coming right up!

questions.questionText: What specific kind of coffee is ordered?
questions.explanation: The customer requests 'vieną juodą kavą' (one black coffee).

questions.questionText: Which size does the buyer pick this time?
questions.explanation: He replies with 'Didelę, ačiū' (Large, thank you).

title: Kava su pienu ryte
transcriptLt: Labas rytas! Noriu kavos su pienu, prašau. Labas rytas! Ar gersite vietoje? Ne, išsinešimui. Vidutinio dydžio? Taip, vidutinę. Minutėlę!
transcriptEn: Good morning! I want a coffee with milk, please. Good morning! Will you drink here? No, to go. Medium size? Yes, medium. One minute!

questions.questionText: What addition does the customer want in his coffee?
questions.explanation: He asks for 'kavos su pienu' (coffee with milk).

questions.questionText: What size coffee does the barista suggest and confirm?
questions.explanation: The barista asks 'Vidutinio dydžio?' and he confirms 'Taip, vidutinę' (Yes, medium).

title: Kava čia, vietoje
transcriptLt: Sveiki, ar galima kapučino? Sveiki, taip! Norite čia ar išsinešti? Norėčiau gerti čia. Mažą ar didelį puodelį? Mažą puodelį, ačiū. Prisėskite, tuoj atnešiu.
transcriptEn: Hello, can I have a cappuccino? Hello, yes! Would you like here or to go? I would like to drink here. A small or a large cup? A small cup, thank you. Have a seat, I'll bring it right away.

questions.questionText: Where will the customer drink his cappuccino?
questions.explanation: He says 'Norėčiau gerti čia' (I would like to drink here).

questions.questionText: What does the barista tell the customer to do at the end?
questions.explanation: She tells him 'Prisėskite, tuoj atnešiu' (Have a seat, I will bring it right away).

title: Dvi kavos išsinešimui
transcriptLt: Labasvakaras! Ar galiu gauti dvi kavas? Sveiki! Taip, čia ar išsinešimui? Dvi juodas kavas išsinešimui, prašau. Kokio dydžio? Dvi dideles. Gerai, minutę!
transcriptEn: Good evening! Can I get two coffees? Hello! Yes, here or to go? Two black coffees to go, please. What size? Two large ones. Okay, one minute!

questions.questionText: How many coffees does the customer order?
questions.explanation: He asks for 'dvi kavas' (two coffees).

questions.questionText: What greeting is used at the start?
questions.explanation: The conversation opens with 'Labas vakaras!' (Good evening!).

title: Espreso ir vanduo
transcriptLt: Laba diena, prašau vieną espreso. Laba diena! Norite čia ar išsinešimui? Gersiu čia. Ar norite stiklinės vandens? Taip, ačiū. Momentą!
transcriptEn: Good day, one espresso please. Good day! Would you like here or to go? I'll drink here. Would you like a glass of water? Yes, thank you. Just a moment!

questions.questionText: What drink option does the barista offer in addition?
questions.explanation: She asks 'Ar norite stiklinės vandens?' (Would you like a glass of water?).

questions.questionText: What type of coffee is ordered?
questions.explanation: The customer orders 'vieną espreso' (one espresso).

title: Šalta kava išsinešimui
transcriptLt: Labas! Ar turite šaltos kavos? Labas! Taip, turime. Ar imsite išsinešimui? Taip, išsinešimui. Didelę ar vidutinę? Vidutinę, prašau. Tuoj paruošiu!
transcriptEn: Hi! Do you have iced coffee? Hi! Yes, we do. Will you take it to go? Yes, to go. Large or medium? Medium, please. I'll prepare it right away!

questions.questionText: What kind of coffee does the customer ask for?
questions.explanation: He asks 'Ar turite šaltos kavos?' (Do you have cold/iced coffee?).

questions.questionText: What size iced coffee does he choose?
questions.explanation: He specifies 'Vidutinę, prašau' (Medium, please).

title: Kava ir cukrus
transcriptLt: Sveiki, prašau vieną mažą kavą. Sveiki! Vietoje ar išsinešti? Išsinešimui. Ar reikės cukraus? Ne, be cukraus, ačiū. Gerai, viena sekundė.
transcriptEn: Hello, one small coffee please. Hello! To stay or to go? To go. Will you need sugar? No, without sugar, thank you. Okay, just a second.

questions.questionText: Does the customer want sugar in his coffee?
questions.explanation: He states 'Ne, be cukraus, ačiū' (No, without sugar, thank you).

questions.questionText: What Lithuanian phrase means 'without sugar'?
questions.explanation: 'Be cukraus' literally translates to 'without sugar'.

title: Mokėjimas už kavą
transcriptLt: Labas, noriu vienos vidutinės kavos išsinešimui. Labas! Gerai, trys eurai. Mokėsite kortele ar grynaisiais? Kortele, prašau. Ačiū, gražios dienos!
transcriptEn: Hi, I want one medium coffee to go. Hi! Okay, three euros. Will you pay by card or cash? By card, please. Thank you, have a nice day!

questions.questionText: How much does the coffee cost?
questions.explanation: The barista says 'trys eurai' (three euros).

questions.questionText: How does the customer decide to pay?
questions.explanation: He replies with 'Kortele, prašau' (By card, please).

title: Duona ir pienas parduotuvėje
transcriptLt: Laba diena, kur yra šviežia duona? Laba diena! Duona yra ten, prie pieno produktų. Ačiū! Ar turite šalto pieno? Taip, šaldytuve kairėje.
transcriptEn: Good day, where is the fresh bread? Good day! The bread is over there, near the dairy products. Thank you! Do you have cold milk? Yes, in the fridge on the left.

questions.questionText: Where is the fresh bread located?
questions.explanation: The worker says 'Duona yra ten, prie pieno produktų' (Bread is over there, near dairy products).

questions.questionText: Where can the customer find cold milk?
options: In the fridge on the left
On the shelf on the right
questions.explanation: The answer is 'šaldytuve kairėje' (in the fridge on the left).

title: Obuoliai ir bananai
transcriptLt: Sveiki, kiek kainuoja šie obuoliai? Sveiki! Obuoliai kainuoja vieną eurą. Gerai, prašau du kilogramus. Ar dar ko nors reikės? Dar prašau tris bananus.
transcriptEn: Hello, how much do these apples cost? Hello! Apples cost one euro. Okay, two kilograms please. Will you need anything else? Also three bananas please.

questions.questionText: How many kilograms of apples does the customer want?
questions.explanation: The customer requests 'du kilogramus' (two kilograms).

questions.questionText: What additional fruit does the customer ask for?
questions.explanation: The customer asks for 'tris bananus' (three bananas).

title: Mokėjimas kasoje
transcriptLt: Laba diena, ar turite nuolaidų kortelę? Ne, neturiu. Viso bus šeši eurai. Ar mokėsite grynaisiais? Ne, mokėsiu kortele. Gerai, priglauskite kortelę čia.
transcriptEn: Good day, do you have a discount card? No, I don't. Total will be six euros. Will you pay in cash? No, I'll pay by card. Okay, tap your card here.

questions.questionText: Does the customer have a discount card?
questions.explanation: He replies with 'Ne, neturiu' (No, I don't have).

questions.questionText: How much is the total amount?
questions.explanation: The cashier says 'Viso bus šeši eurai' (Total will be six euros).

title: Bakaleja ir vanduo
transcriptLt: Labas, kur yra negazuotas vanduo? Labas! Negazuotas vanduo yra trečioje eilėje. Ačiū. Ar reikės maišelio? Taip, prašau vieną mažą maišelį.
transcriptEn: Hi, where is still water? Hi! Still water is in the third aisle. Thank you. Will you need a bag? Yes, one small bag please.

questions.questionText: Which aisle contains the still water?
questions.explanation: The worker states 'trečioje eilėje' (in the third aisle).

questions.questionText: What type of bag does the customer request?
questions.explanation: The customer requests 'vieną mažą maišelį' (one small bag).

title: Sūris ir sviestas
transcriptLt: Sveiki, ar turite lietuviško sūrio? Taip, turime labai skanaus sūrio. Prašau du šimtus gramų. Gerai. Ar dar reikės sviesto? Ne, sviesto jau turiu, ačiū.
transcriptEn: Hello, do you have Lithuanian cheese? Yes, we have very tasty cheese. Please give me two hundred grams. Okay. Will you also need butter? No, I already have butter, thank you.

questions.questionText: How much cheese does the buyer order?
questions.explanation: The buyer requests 'du šimtus gramų' (two hundred grams).

questions.questionText: Why does the customer decline the butter?
questions.explanation: The customer states 'sviesto jau turiu' (I already have butter).

title: Kur yra stotelė?
transcriptLt: Atsiprašau, kur yra autobusų stotelė? Stotelė yra tiesiai ir kairėje, prie parko. Ar tai toli? Ne, vos trys minutės pėsčiomis. Labai ačiū!
transcriptEn: Excuse me, where is the bus stop? The stop is straight and on the left, near the park. Is it far? No, just three minutes on foot. Thank you very much!

questions.questionText: Where is the bus stop located?
options: On the right next to the school
questions.explanation: The directions given are 'tiesiai ir kairėje' (straight and on the left).

questions.questionText: How long does it take to walk there?
questions.explanation: The passerby answers 'vos trys minutės pėsčiomis' (just three minutes on foot).

title: Bilietas autobuse
transcriptLt: Laba diena, vieną bilietą, prašau. Laba diena! Vienas bilietas kainuoja vieną eurą. Ar galima mokėti kortele? Taip, priglauskite kortelę prie aparato. Ačiū!
transcriptEn: Good day, one ticket please. Good day! One ticket costs one euro. Can I pay by card? Yes, tap your card on the device. Thank you!

questions.questionText: How much does one bus ticket cost?
questions.explanation: The response is 'Vienas bilietas kainuoja vieną eurą' (One ticket costs one euro).

questions.questionText: How does the passenger pay for the ticket?
questions.explanation: The driver instructs to 'priglauskite kortelę prie aparato' (tap your card on the device).

title: Muziejus centre
transcriptLt: Atsiprašau, kaip nueiti iki muziejaus? Eikite tiesiai, tada sukite į dešinę. Ar muziejus yra prie uostamiesčio aikštės? Taip, visai šalia aikštės. Ačiū už pagalbą!
transcriptEn: Excuse me, how do I walk to the museum? Go straight, then turn right. Is the museum near the square? Yes, right next to the square. Thanks for the help!

questions.questionText: What turn should the person take after walking straight?
questions.explanation: The instruction is 'sukite į dešinę' (turn right).

questions.questionText: What landmark is the museum close to?
questions.explanation: The answer confirms it is 'visai šalia aikštės' (right next to the square).

title: Traukinys į Kauną
transcriptLt: Sveiki, kada išvyksta kitas traukinys į Kauną? Sveiki! Kitas traukinys išvyksta keturioliktą valandą. Iš kurio perono? Iš antro perono. Ačiū!
transcriptEn: Hello, when does the next train to Kaunas leave? Hello! The next train leaves at 14:00. From which platform? From platform two. Thank you!

questions.questionText: At what time does the train to Kaunas leave?
questions.explanation: The agent says 'keturioliktą valandą' (at 14:00 / 2 PM).

questions.questionText: Which platform will the train depart from?
questions.explanation: The train leaves 'Iš antro perono' (From platform 2).

title: Taksi iškvietimas
transcriptLt: Labas, ar galiu užsakyti taksi į oro uostą? Taip, kur jūs esate? Aš esu Gedimino prospekte dešimt. Taksi atvažiuos už septynių minučių. Puiku, laukiu!
transcriptEn: Hi, can I order a taxi to the airport? Yes, where are you? I'm at Gedimino avenue 10. The taxi will arrive in seven minutes. Great, I'll wait!

questions.questionText: Where does the passenger want to go?
questions.explanation: The passenger asks for a taxi 'į oro uostą' (to the airport).

questions.questionText: How long will it take for the taxi to arrive?
questions.explanation: The operator states 'už septynių minučių' (in seven minutes).

title: Staliuko rezervacija
transcriptLt: Laba diena, ar turite laisvą staliuką dviem? Laba diena! Taip, prie lango ar viduryje? Prie lango, prašau. Prašom sėstis, štai meniu. Ačiū labai.
transcriptEn: Good day, do you have a free table for two? Good day! Yes, by the window or in the middle? By the window, please. Please sit down, here is the menu. Thank you very much.

questions.questionText: How many people is the table for?
questions.explanation: The customer asks for a table 'dviem' (for two).

questions.questionText: Where does the customer prefer to sit?
questions.explanation: The customer chooses 'Prie lango, prašau' (By the window, please).

title: Dienos sriuba
transcriptLt: Atsiprašau, kokia šiandien dienos sriuba? Šiandien turime pomidorų sriubą. Puiku, man vieną pomidorų sriubą. Ar gersite ko nors? Taip, mineralinio vandens.
transcriptEn: Excuse me, what is today's soup of the day? Today we have tomato soup. Great, one tomato soup for me. Will you drink anything? Yes, mineral water.

questions.questionText: What is the soup of the day?
questions.explanation: The waiter replies 'Šiandien turime pomidorų sriubą' (Today we have tomato soup).

questions.questionText: What drink does the guest order?
questions.explanation: The guest orders 'mineralinio vandens' (mineral water).

title: Pagrindinis patiekalas
transcriptLt: Ar jau išsirinkote? Taip, norėčiau vištienos su ryžiais. Ar patiekalas aštrus? Ne, visai neaštrus. Labai gerai, ačiū. Tuoj atnešiu!
transcriptEn: Have you chosen yet? Yes, I would like chicken with rice. Is the dish spicy? No, not spicy at all. Very good, thank you. I'll bring it shortly!

questions.questionText: What main dish does the guest select?
questions.explanation: The guest orders 'vištienos su ryžiais' (chicken with rice).

questions.questionText: Is the dish spicy?
questions.explanation: The waiter clarifies 'Ne, visai neaštrus' (No, not spicy at all).

title: Desertas ir arbata
transcriptLt: Ar norėtumėte deserto? Taip, ar turite obuolių pyrago? Taip, turime! Ir prašau puodelį žalios arbatos. Supratau, vienas pyragas ir žalia arbata.
transcriptEn: Would you like dessert? Yes, do you have apple pie? Yes, we do! And please a cup of green tea. Understood, one pie and green tea.

questions.questionText: Which dessert does the customer order?
questions.explanation: The customer orders 'obuolių pyrago' (apple pie).

questions.questionText: What kind of tea does the customer want?
questions.explanation: The customer requests 'žalios arbatos' (green tea).

title: Sąskaita restorane
transcriptLt: Atsiprašau, ar galima sąskaitą? Taip, žinoma. Ar viskas patiko? Maistas buvo labai skanus! Džiugu girdėti. Viso bus penkiolika eurų.
transcriptEn: Excuse me, can I have the bill? Yes, of course. Did you enjoy everything? The food was very delicious! Glad to hear. Total will be fifteen euros.

questions.questionText: Did the customer like the food?
questions.explanation: The customer answers 'Maistas buvo labai skanus!' (The food was very delicious!).

questions.questionText: What is the total amount of the bill?
questions.explanation: The total is 'penkiolika eurų' (15 euros).

title: Marškinėlių paieška
transcriptLt: Laba diena, ar galiu kuo nors padėti? Laba diena, ieškau mėlynų marškinėlių. Kokio dydžio ieškote? Medium dydžio, prašau. Štai, pasimatuokite šiuos.
transcriptEn: Good day, can I help you with anything? Good day, I'm looking for a blue t-shirt. What size are you looking for? Medium size, please. Here, try these on.

questions.questionText: What color item is the buyer looking for?
questions.explanation: The buyer says 'ieškau mėlynų marškinėlių' (I am looking for a blue t-shirt).

questions.questionText: Which size does the customer ask for?
questions.explanation: The buyer specifies 'Medium dydžio, prašau' (Medium size, please).

title: Pasimatavimo kabina
transcriptLt: Atsiprašau, kur yra matavimosi kabina? Kabinos yra gale, dešinėje pusėje. Ačiū. Ar kelnės tinka? Taip, kelnės tinka puikiai!
transcriptEn: Excuse me, where is the fitting room? The fitting rooms are at the back, on the right side. Thank you. Do the pants fit? Yes, the pants fit perfectly!

questions.questionText: Where are the fitting rooms located?
options: At the back on the right side
questions.explanation: The staff points 'gale, dešinėje pusėje' (at the back, on the right side).

questions.questionText: How do the pants fit?
questions.explanation: The customer answers 'kelnės tinka puikiai!' (pants fit perfectly!).

title: Kita spalva
transcriptLt: Sveiki, ar turite šį megztinį juodos spalvos? Sveiki, momentą, patikrinsiu. Taip, turime paskutinį juodą. Kokia jo kaina? Kainuoja trisdešimt eurų.
transcriptEn: Hello, do you have this sweater in black color? Hello, one moment, I'll check. Yes, we have the last black one. What is its price? It costs thirty euros.

questions.questionText: Which color of the sweater does the customer inquire about?
questions.explanation: The customer asks for 'juodos spalvos' (black color).

questions.questionText: How much does the sweater cost?
questions.explanation: The worker replies 'Kainuoja trisdešimt eurų' (Costs thirty euros).

title: Batų paieška
transcriptLt: Laba diena, ar turite šiuos batus keturiasdešimt antro dydžio? Laba diena, taip, turime! Ar norite pasimatuoti? Taip, prašau. Štai, prašom.
transcriptEn: Good day, do you have these shoes in size 42? Good day, yes we do! Would you like to try them on? Yes, please. Here you go.

questions.questionText: What shoe size is requested?
questions.explanation: The customer asks for 'keturiasdešimt antro dydžio' (size 42).

questions.questionText: Is the requested shoe size in stock?
questions.explanation: The assistant confirms 'taip, turime!' (yes, we have!).

title: Grąžinimas ir čekis
transcriptLt: Laba diena, ar galiu grąžinti šią striukę? Laba diena, taip, ar turite pirkimo čekį? Taip, štai čekis. Gerai, grąžinsime pinigus į kortelę.
transcriptEn: Good day, can I return this jacket? Good day, yes, do you have the purchase receipt? Yes, here is the receipt. Okay, we will refund the money to your card.

questions.questionText: What item does the customer want to return?
questions.explanation: The customer asks 'ar galiu grąžinti šią striukę?' (can I return this jacket?).

questions.questionText: Where will the money be refunded?
questions.explanation: The employee states 'grąžinsime pinigus į kortelę' (we will refund money to the card).

title: Kambario registracija
transcriptLt: Laba diena, turiu rezervaciją vardu Jonas. Laba diena! Taip, matau rezervaciją dviviečiam kambariui. Prašau jūsų paso. Štai mano pasas. Ačiū!
transcriptEn: Good day, I have a reservation under the name Jonas. Good day! Yes, I see a reservation for a double room. Please give me your passport. Here is my passport. Thank you!

questions.questionText: Under what name is the reservation held?
questions.explanation: The guest says 'turiu rezervaciją vardu Jonas' (I have a reservation under the name Jonas).

questions.questionText: What document does the receptionist request?
questions.explanation: The receptionist requests 'Prašau jūsų paso' (Please give me your passport).

title: Pusryčių laikas
transcriptLt: Atsiprašau, kelintą valandą yra pusryčiai? Pusryčiai yra nuo septintos iki dešimtos valandos. Kur jie vyksta? Pirme aukšte, restorane. Ačiū už informaciją!
transcriptEn: Excuse me, what time is breakfast? Breakfast is from 7:00 to 10:00 o'clock. Where does it take place? On the first floor, in the restaurant. Thanks for the information!

questions.questionText: What time is breakfast served?
questions.explanation: The answer is 'nuo septintos iki dešimtos valandos' (from 7:00 to 10:00).

questions.questionText: On which floor is the breakfast restaurant located?
questions.explanation: The location is specified as 'Pirme aukšte' (On the first floor).

title: Wi-Fi slaptažodis
transcriptLt: Labas, koks yra Wi-Fi slaptažodis? Labas! Slaptažodis parašytas ant šios kortelės. Ar internetas nemokamas? Taip, nemokamas visame viešbutyje. Labai gerai, ačiū!
transcriptEn: Hi, what is the Wi-Fi password? Hi! The password is written on this card. Is the internet free? Yes, free throughout the entire hotel. Very good, thank you!

questions.questionText: Where can the guest find the Wi-Fi password?
questions.explanation: The staff says 'parašytas ant šios kortelės' (written on this card).

questions.questionText: Does the guest have to pay for Wi-Fi?
questions.explanation: The staff confirms 'Taip, nemokamas visame viešbutyje' (Yes, free in the whole hotel).

title: Kambario raktas
transcriptLt: Atsiprašau, mano kambario raktas neveikia. Koks jūsų kambario numeris? Kambarys šimtas keturiolika. Tuoj pakeisiu kortelę. Štai, prašau naują raktą. Ačiū už pagalbą!
transcriptEn: Excuse me, my room key is not working. What is your room number? Room 114. I'll change the card right away. Here is your new key. Thanks for the help!

questions.questionText: What is the guest's room number?
questions.explanation: The guest states 'Kambarys šimtas keturiolika' (Room 114).

questions.questionText: How does the receptionist solve the issue?
questions.explanation: The receptionist says 'Tuoj pakeisiu kortelę' (I'll replace the card right away).

title: Išsiregistravimas iš viešbučio
transcriptLt: Laba diena, noriu išsiregistruoti. Laba diena! Štai jūsų kambario raktas. Ačiū. Ar naudojotės mini baru? Ne, nenaudojau. Gerai, gražios kelionės!
transcriptEn: Good day, I want to check out. Good day! Here is your room key. Thank you. Did you use the mini-bar? No, I didn't. Okay, have a nice trip!

questions.questionText: What action is the guest taking?
questions.explanation: The guest opens with 'noriu išsiregistruoti' (I want to check out).

questions.questionText: Did the guest consume items from the mini-bar?
questions.explanation: The guest answers 'Ne, nenaudojau' (No, I didn't use it).

title: Vaistai nuo galvos skausmo
transcriptLt: Laba diena, ar turite vaistų nuo galvos skausmo? Laba diena! Taip, turime šių tablečių. Kaip jas gerti? Gerkite po vieną tabletę du kartus per dieną. Ačiū!
transcriptEn: Good day, do you have medicine for a headache? Good day! Yes, we have these tablets. How to take them? Take one tablet twice a day. Thank you!

questions.questionText: What condition does the customer need medicine for?
questions.explanation: The customer asks for 'vaistų nuo galvos skausmo' (headache medicine).

questions.questionText: What is the recommended dosage?
options: Two tablets three times a day
questions.explanation: The pharmacist advises 'po vieną tabletę du kartus per dieną' (one tablet twice a day).

title: Vaistai nuo peršalimo
transcriptLt: Sveiki, aš persišaldžiau. Ar turite arbatos nuo peršalimo? Sveiki! Taip, turime žolelių arbatos. Taip pat rekomenduoju vitaminą C. Gerai, paimsiu abu. Ačiū!
transcriptEn: Hello, I caught a cold. Do you have tea for a cold? Hello! Yes, we have herbal tea. I also recommend vitamin C. Okay, I'll take both. Thank you!

questions.questionText: What product did the customer originally ask for?
questions.explanation: The customer asks 'Ar turite arbatos nuo peršalimo?' (Do you have cold tea?).

questions.questionText: What additional product does the pharmacist recommend?
questions.explanation: The pharmacist suggests 'vitaminą C' (Vitamin C).

title: Pleistras ir dezinfekcija

transcriptEn: Excuse me, do you have this prescription medicine? Yes, please show your prescription or ID document. Here is my ID card. Thank you, I see your e-prescription. I'll bring it right away.
